notes.subject: אל
notes.rationale: rendered Elohim per discipline; not 'God' or 'Bikpela'

notes.subject: יחתך
notes.rationale: verb חתה 'to pick up (fire)'; versions split: 'take thee away' vs 'snatch up'; rendered 'holim' keeping the seizing sense

notes.subject: יתצך יחתך ויסחך
notes.rationale: three 2nd-person suffix verbs pile up in succession, violent staccato judgment; partially lost

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: Hebrew suffix -ך carries 'thee'; Tok Pisin needs free pronoun ⟨yu⟩

translation: Gutpela tok: Elohim bai i bagarapim ⟨yu⟩ oltaim olgeta, em bai i holim ⟨yu⟩ na pulim ⟨yu⟩ ausait long haus sel bilong ⟨yu⟩, na rausim rot bilong ⟨yu⟩ long graun bilong ol man i stap alaive. Sela.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i stap alaive
